blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos on Sunday greeted Wilfredo “Tata Willy” Avila, a longtime photographer of the Marcos family who celebrated his 89th birthday. In his latest vlog on Sunday, Marcos made a special mention of Avila, describing him as a family member who had been with them through decades of political highs and lows.
